name: Modernist Kaunas: Architecture of Optimism, 1919-1939
description: In the 1920s and 30s, Kaunas was Lithuania's provisional capital, and it grew from a provincial town into a modern city almost overnight. Around 12,000 modernist buildings went up between 1919 and 1940, and many still stand in the Naujamiestis (New Town) and Žaliakalnis (Green Hill) districts. Look for the Central Post Office, the Vytautas the Great War Museum and the Church of the Resurrection of Christ.
